title: Save now, because the place for the city is not yet revealed
setting: This revelation came at Kirtland, Ohio, on 10 March 1831. More than a hundred Church members from New York were expected to arrive soon. Earlier revelations had told them to gather to Ohio. Ohio members, including Bishop Edward Partridge, asked how to prepare for them. John Whitmer also wrote that some believed Ohio itself was the promised New Jerusalem.
summary: The revelation tells the Ohio members to stay where they live for now. Those who own land should share it with the eastern members. Those without land should buy for the present in nearby regions. All should save money and gain what they can in righteousness. That money will later buy land for an inheritance, “even the city”. The place of the city is not yet revealed. Men will be appointed to learn the place, buy the lands, and begin building. Then families will gather under the direction of the presidency and the bishop.

contextNote.title: A city not yet located
contextNote.text: Some members thought Ohio was already the gathering place. Verse 5 corrects that idea: “The place is not yet to be revealed”. Verse 1 explains why members should stay put “for the present time”. Verse 4 shows what the waiting is for: saving money to buy land for the city. Verse 6 adds the order of events: appointed men first, then families. In this passage, waiting is an active stage of preparation, not a delay.

ldsText: The 2025 Come, Follow Me lesson covering sections 46–48 includes this counsel about receiving the gathering Saints. How do verses 2–4 ask members with land and members without land to prepare in different ways?
reviewNote: Read all 6 verses. Official heading gives Kirtland, 10 March 1831, on obtaining land for arriving Saints. JSP adds the expected arrival of over a hundred New York members, Partridge’s role as bishop, and Whitmer’s note about the Ohio-as-New-Jerusalem misunderstanding. Edward Partridge is not named in the text; included as the bishop in v. 6 per JSP. Fact-check 2026-10-12: no changes.
